title: The Fossil in a Museum Drawer
short_teaser: Some major discoveries happen not in the field but when old collections are reexamined with new questions or better tools.
story: Some major discoveries happen not in the field but when old collections are reexamined with new questions or better tools. A specimen gathered decades earlier can suddenly become important. A new perspective can change the value of information that has been sitting quietly for years. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist explaining it away too quickly. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A new perspective can change the value of information that has been sitting quietly for years. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist explaining it away too quickly.
spark_application: Write down one unexpected result or unanswered question from your own work. List three possible explanations before choosing one. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
